citedSentences.text: The separate shelf and its packing note explained all three spare screws.
Leila watched the three screws secure the reading shelf and knew what they were for.
The packing note corrected that belief: the shelf travelled separately and the screws were deliberately supplied loose.

priorHook.expectedPayoff: A small bell rang inside the sealed delivery crate whenever it tilted, though the packing list named no bell.

citedSentences.text: The crate maker’s mark matched a bell-shaped stamp under the lid, but nobody could identify the maker or the bell’s purpose.
Once the permitted unpacking was complete, Tom could see the stamp without disturbing any sealed compartment.
The bell-shaped stamp might be a maker’s emblem rather than an operating instruction.
Their observation connected two marks, not a mark and a mechanism.
If the bell were an alarm, opening the lid might stop it, but they did not establish any alarm mechanism.
They had opened the lid and still heard the sound when the crate tilted.
